key_corrections_from_deep_dive: CRITICAL: drying_technology: auto_open (AutoAir) → condensation_only (PureDry). AutoAir is 500+ exclusive.
P axis: 7.0 → 6.0 (massive shift from 3 performance corrections)
top_failure_modes: 1. E15 water in base pan — sump gasket, pump seal degradation. AquaStop catches it.
2. E24/E25 drain failure — filter clogging (user maintenance), kinked hose, drain pump.
3. Control board E01 — pump control circuit failure, typically after 5+ years. 5-yr warranty covers.

bsh_platform_disclosure.no_autoair_advantage: 300 avoids the AutoAir door mechanism failure mode documented on the 500
